confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the heating element has most likely failed. On Beko vented dryers like your DV7110, this is the standard part that goes' and heading 'Likely cause: heater element' with no continuity test and ignoring the clogged-vent clue pointing to a thermal cut-out

unjustifiedPart.evidence: 'To find the correct heating element, you will need to locate the full model number... Once you have the correct part, ensure the dryer is unplugged before attempting replacement' - directs purchase of an element without any test of cut-out or element

rationale: The assistant sensibly started with unplugging and clearing the filter and later correctly refused to give a part number without the full model, pointing the customer to a spares dealer. However, it jumped from 'still cold after cleaning' straight to 'the heating element has most likely failed' and never mentioned the thermal cut-out as the prime suspect despite the customer twice flagging a heavily clogged vent hose, nor did it suggest continuity testing or an engineer for testing before buying. It also wrongly referred to a 'condenser unit' on a vented dryer. The customer leaves set to source an element that may not be the faulty component.
